items.guidance: In CTFd, serve.py is the Flask development server entry point and wsgi.py exposes the WSGI app; confirm the Dockerfile's production start runs a WSGI server (for example gunicorn against the app in wsgi.py) bound to 0.0.0.0:8000 rather than invoking serve.py. If wsgi.py itself calls a run method with a loopback host, guard that call behind a development-only condition so importing the app object for the WSGI server is unaffected.
